items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I'm not Perry Bradford, and I'm not Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: So it was only when maybe they'd buy one and run it in a cabaret, like this was a new innovation or something like that, but otherwise it wasn't known. But we heard about the 'Crazy Blues' and Mamie Smith for the simple reason why. So many people was always coming back from New York to Atlantic City all the time, cause now Atlantic City was the summer Mecca, while New York was the winter Mecca, you know what I mean? Of the people in the life.
Because if you wasn't in the life, you didn't go to cabarets in those days.
